name: Ronak Shah
player_statement:
A complete player, Ronak Shah has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 18, with an average of 5.71 and a quick strike rate of 93.02. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 2 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 15.4 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 12.38. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
